concerns.text: T009's third deliverable — 'Also a scatter of the strongest metric–BMRQ correlation with partial-r annotation' — names no output file path, unlike the other two figures. An implementer cannot verify completion deterministically. Name it, e.g. `figures/scatter_top_metric_bmrq.png`.

T010's determinism check ('re-run of the connectivity/metrics pipeline on a held-out real subject to confirm determinism') has no named artifact recording the outcome; the Verification clause only covers the three JSONs (sensitivity, resource usage). Add a determinism result file (e.g. `data/determinism_check.json` with both run hashes) or fold it into an existing artifact.

Verification requires a 'missing-BMRQ simulation exits 1 with the gap report' but the task body gives no mechanism for how the simulation is induced (fixture behavioral table? CLI flag? mocked fetch?). Specify the test setup so the contract test is executable without network-dependent failure injection.

T002 bundles two distinct preprocessing paths (fMRIPrep off-CI wrapper + nilearn CI path) plus FD computation plus run-log writing plus threshold unit tests in one task — coarse relative to the rest of the list; consider splitting the CI-tractable nilearn path from the off-CI fMRIPrep wrapper so the CI-verifiable half can complete and be checked independently.
